rows.note: Use this for behavior or emotion that is excessively dramatic or exaggerated, without necessarily stressing that it is affected.

example.english: Their reaction was histrionic, and everyone in the room could hear them crying.
example.traditional: 佢一聽到個消息就誇張到喊晒出嚟，成間房都聽到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 go3 siu1 sik1 zau6 kwaa1 zoeng1 dou3 haam3 saai3 ceot1 lai4 seng4 gaan1 fong4 dou1 teng1 dou3

rows.note: Use this when the dramatic behavior seems affected, artificial, or deliberately attention-seeking.

example.english: You don't have to be so histrionic; it was only a fall, not the end of the world.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁做作，跌親啫，唔係世界末日。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 zou6 zok3 dit3 can1 ze1 m4 hai6 sai3 gaai3 mut6 jat6

rows.note: Use this attributively for things connected with drama, actors, or acting, rather than for attention-seeking behavior.

example.english: This arts festival has a histrionic performance by local actors.
example.traditional: 今次藝術節有本地演員演出嘅戲劇節目。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngai6 seot6 zit3 jau5 bun2 dei6 jin2 jyun4 jin2 ceot1 ge3 hei3 kek6 zit3 muk6
